fabrishot.config.title: Fabrishot
fabrishot.config.custom_file_name.toolti:
Use %time% for the time,
 %world% for world or server name
fabrishot.config.delay.tooltip: Frames to wait after resizing. Tweak for better exposure with shaders
fabrishot.error.side_too_large: Fabrishot: %sx%s exceeds the maximum texture size of %s, the capture was cancelled
fabrishot.error.too_many_pixels: Fabrishot: %sx%s has too many pixels (maximum %s megapixels), the capture was cancelled
fabrishot.error.capture_failed: Fabrishot: the %sx%s capture failed and was cancelled
fabrishot.config.flashback.unavailable: Flashback not installed — WebP/TIFF/AVIF hidden (the built-in encoder is used)
fabrishot.config.png_compression.tooltip: 0 = no compression (larger file), 9 = maximum compression (slower). This does not affect image quality.
fabrishot.config.jpg_color_sampling.tool: 4:4:4 = best colour accuracy, 4:2:0 = smallest file size. 4:4:4 is limited to 140 megapixels.
fabrishot.config.webp_lossless.tooltip: Ignore the quality slider; encode without any quality loss
fabrishot.config.webp_quality.tooltip: Higher = better quality (100 = best, only used when lossless is off)
fabrishot.config.tiff_compression.toolti: LZW provides the best balance of size and compatibility. LZW is limited to images under 134 megapixels; larger images fall back to deflate.
fabrishot.config.avif_tune.tooltip: SSIM: optimises for perceptual quality; PSNR: optimises for peak signal-to-noise ratio
fabrishot.config.avif_color_sampling.too: 4:4:4 = best colour accuracy, 4:2:0 = smallest file size
fabrishot.config.debug_encode_stats.tool: Write the time spent in every stage of each screenshot encode, and FFmpeg's own diagnostics, to the game log
fabrishot.notice.format_fallback: Fabrishot: %s requires Flashback, the file format was reset to PNG
fabrishot.notice.encoder_fallback: Fabrishot: fell back to %s for this screenshot (%s)
fabrishot.error.too_many_pixels_for_form: Fabrishot: %sx%s is too large for %s (%s), the screenshot was not saved
fabrishot.error.stack_memory: Fabrishot: stacking %sx%s needs about %s MB, but only %s MB is safely available; lower the resolution or enable low memory mode
fabrishot.error.stack_timeout: Fabrishot: the stacking capture timed out; only the frames that were processed were used (the result may be incomplete)
fabrishot.error.stack_oom: Fabrishot: ran out of memory while stacking; the stacking capture was aborted
fabrishot.config.stack_mode.tooltip:
AVERAGE: averages the frames in linear light, which is what a real long exposure integrates; a little slower
MAXIMUM: lighten / star trails
MINIMUM: darken
fabrishot.config.stack_count.tooltip: Number of screenshots to capture and merge (%s to %s)
fabrishot.config.stack_interval.tooltip: Rendered frames to wait between captures (not game ticks). Lower it if the frame rate is low. Press Esc during a capture to stop early.
fabrishot.config.stack_low_memory: Reduces memory usage, at the cost of precision and speed
fabrishot.config.stack_low_memory.toolti: AVERAGE keeps a Q16 running mean (6 bytes per pixel instead of 12) and composites the frames serially in capture order. Halves the accumulator memory, costs about 3x CPU and a little precision. MAXIMUM and MINIMUM are unaffected.
fabrishot.stack.cancelled: Fabrishot: the stacking capture was cancelled, no frames were taken
fabrishot.notice.stack_frames: Fabrishot: stacking %s frames takes a long time; lower the frame count or the frame interval if the game stutters or the capture times out
fabrishot.notice.stack_queued: Fabrishot: this stacking capture is queued and starts when the background composite finishes
fabrishot.notice.stack_busy: Fabrishot: the previous stacking capture is still being processed, try again later
